title: Nested child expands beyond parent allocation
description: Parent grants child A 40 units from a 100-unit root budget. Child A attempts to delegate 50 to child B.
expected_invariants: Child delegation cannot exceed the delegator's unspent and delegable allocation unless an explicit parent-authorized reallocation occurs.
failure_mode: Nested delegation silently expands child A's 40-unit budget to 50.
